outcome: Maternal clinical manifestations (epigastric pain, vomiting, headache, dizziness, edema of feet, blurring of vision, convulsion)
Past history of gestational hypertension (in multiparous women)
Previous lower segment caesarean section (in multiparous women)
cohort: 70 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational hypertension at >=20 weeks of gestation, presenting to Sree Mookambika institute of medical sciences hospital.
finding: Gestational hypertension was more prevalent in young nulliparous women (19-24 years old) and presented with a variety of clinical manifestations, which can aid in early diagnosis.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, for women at >=20 weeks of gestation, upon presentation with gestational hypertension.
